decisions.reason: This lever handle family sits close to the core range and costs little to keep listed, and its survival while sibling handles A, D and E were cut suggests the 2018-2019 results favored it.
This handle design is a low-cost option within the established portfolio and survived the 2019 pruning, but door handle designs turn over quickly, so a later drop is a moderate risk.

The L700 electronic access system with its unique light technology was rebranded and upgraded to LightAccess Pro, which signals a further commitment in line with the firm's move toward digital building organization, so its option value remains high.
